external_resources: CM4AI project web portal at https://cm4ai.org/, providing project overview, data releases, tools, product documentation, publications, and learning materials.
MassIVE Repository, holding the SEC-MS and AP-MS mass spectrometry data referenced by this release.
Figshare, holding the CRISPRi Perturbation Atlas of iPSCs.
Network Data Exchange (NDEx), via which CM4AI cell maps are shared and which can be visualized in a web browser or accessed via tools such as Cytoscape, HiView, and the Python ndex2 library.

Cell Mapping Toolkit, a series of Python packages implementing the end-to-end cell map construction pipeline, at https://github.com/idekerlab/cellmaps_pipeline with user documentation at https://cellmaps-pipeline.readthedocs.io/.
FAIRSCAPE AI-readiness framework, described with a tutorial and installation instructions at https://fairscape.github.io, available under the MIT License.
Integrative Modeling Platform (IMP) package, available at http://integrativemodeling.org.

third_party_sharing.notes: Component data are additionally deposited in external repositories: SEC-MS and AP-MS mass spectrometry data at the MassIVE Repository, and the CRISPRi Perturbation Atlas of iPSCs at Figshare. Perturb-seq data in KOLF2.1J iPSCs and in MDA-MB-468 cells are listed as Embargoed.
